text:
Ulmford fleet vehicle count: 9,500.

- Mira wants the print room kept clear for visitors.
- The print room is being repainted; expect noise in the afternoon.
- The lift near the north office is slow today.
- Hugo is out for the rest of the week; Cora is covering.
- Ines is involved in the print room matter.

Previous notes retained:
- Rafe inquired about north office availability in the evening.
- Afternoon stand-up moved to the north office.
- Leon finds the loading bay too cold in the afternoon.
